title: Registry gate allowed network capability references to escape through callback parameters

reproduction.beforeFix: The checker returned pass when globalThis.fetch was passed to a callback whose parameter performed the request.
reproduction.afterFix: Any statically named fetch property access or destructured fetch binding is rejected before function-parameter dataflow can hide it.

relatedForms: const forward = (request: typeof fetch) => request(...); forward(globalThis.fetch)
const connect = (Socket: typeof WebSocket) => new Socket(...); connect(globalThis.WebSocket)
const request = (Client: typeof XMLHttpRequest) => new Client(); request(globalThis.XMLHttpRequest)
const stream = (Feed: typeof EventSource) => new Feed(...); stream(globalThis.EventSource)
const beacon = (send: typeof navigator.sendBeacon) => send(...); beacon(navigator.sendBeacon)
const forward = (request: typeof fetch) => request(...); forward(fetch)
remediation: Reject static access to network-capability members and destructured network-capability bindings regardless of receiver, so resource code cannot pass fetch, WebSocket, XMLHttpRequest, EventSource, or sendBeacon into callback parameters.

validation.focusedRegression: 2 tests passed; 23 Window/Document alias and callback-transfer forms rejected across fetch, WebSocket, XMLHttpRequest, EventSource, and sendBeacon, including bare fetch.
